english.title: Occupier of domestic property fail to take measures to secure transfer of household waste is authorised
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the occupier of a domestic property in England or Wales, namely **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..), failed to take all measures available to you, as were reasonable in the circumstances, to secure that a transfer by you, of household waste produced on the property, was

(A)_[to an authorised person]_
(B)_[to a person for authorised transport purposes]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 34(2A) and (6) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

failed to take all measures available to him
as were reasonable in the circumstances
to secure that a transfer by him
of household waste produced on the property
was to an authorised person OR

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence wording document provides for the offence under section 34(2A); prior to 7th January 2019, this offence was included under EP90024, which has been split to provide a separate offence wording for each subsection covered by that document. See also EP90023 in relation to subsection (1), EP90136 in relation to subsection (1A), and EP90138 in relation to subsection (5).

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

In relation to a person who fails to comply with the duty imposed by section 34(2A), an Enforcement Authority may issue a fixed penalty notice, as per section 34ZA.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
